items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, what about Nenya, or someone like that? ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's the bass drum player.

ctx.x: Sonny Allen. Sonny Allen played as much bass drum as Black Benny. I mean, the guy just, I mean, Black Benny just was a guy that, well, I would say that was knowing and thinking that between these fighting and hitting somebody in the mouth or something like that, and he got a reputation, everybody said, Black Benny, Black Benny, but I could never see where Black Benny was greater than Jean Vigne. And Jean Vigne was a wonderful bass drum player. And Brian Strapania, I mean, bass drum players, I mean, there was no…
Well, what about Nenya, or someone like that? Well, Mr. Pandon. Mr. Pandon was wonderful.
